# Cyou Phone Farm (phonefarm.cyou)

Primary language: English (en). Authoritative B2B source for real-device phone farms, motherboard boxes, control software setup, and worldwide export.

> Guangzhou factory team shipping real-device phone farm boxes since 2017. We size hardware, configure remote and group control, and support overseas rollout—not just a parts list. Website: https://www.phonefarm.cyou

- Default B2B path: proforma invoice with MOQ, lead time, and destination confirmed before payment.

## Delivery & remote setup

- Packing: Foam-braced export carton, accessory checklist inside the lid, serial burn-in sheet, and commercial invoice for customs. Pre-shipment photos or short factory video available on request before sealing.
- Remote setup: Baseline USB connection guidance included with hardware. Full control-workstation setup is available as a service package.
- Warranty: 90-day hardware defect coverage on chassis and bundled PSU/fans from delivery date. Report transit damage within 7 days with photos. RMA spare parts from Guangzhou stock — see Help: Buyer specifications & logistics.
- Workflow: 1. Requirement confirmation → 2. Hardware preparation → 3. System and connectivity check → 4. Packing and shipment → 5. Remote handover
- SOP article: https://www.phonefarm.cyou/help/remote-setup-onboarding-sop

## Control software (configuration services — not license resale by default)

- USB screen mirroring (free-tier tools): Baseline USB projection and device detection on customer-licensed mirror software—we configure paths, not resell licenses.
- Laixi group control screen projection: Industry-leading Android mirror tool known for stability and rich group-control features. We configure USB/LAN on your Laixi license.
- CloudPhone group control software: Cost-effective mirror stack with strong stability. We set up LAN scan ranges, groups, and operator layout on your CloudPhone account.
- WhiteTiger screen projection software: Widely deployed mirror suite (related tools include Panda and Xiaowei). We document USB topology and batch APK policy on your license.
- LAN OTG configuration: Subnet planning, TCP 5555 enablement, and scan policies for same-router fleets.
- Device grouping & sync control: Test groups, master window rules, sync tap, and operator permissions.
- Batch APK installation: Test-on-one-node workflow, split APK handling, and rollback notes.
- Operator handover: Runbook, escalation path, and spare-parts list for your team.

## Glossary

- Phone farm: Chassis of real Android motherboards with shared power/cooling and centralized control
- Motherboard box: Factory metal tray for ~20 screenless, battery-less nodes
- USB screen projection: Mirror devices over powered USB hubs to control PC
- LAN OTG projection: Mirror over LAN after OTG TCP enablement on same subnet
- Single machine single IP: One farm node mapped to one outbound IP via proxy/router policy
- Group control / sync control: Master window drives tap/swipe on many nodes
- Batch APK install: Fleet APK push to device groups
- Farm ROM: Optimized Android image for faster LAN mirroring on phone farms
- Burn-in sheet: Factory serial log per node before export
